name: Incident triage
description: When an alert fires, classify its severity with AI, open a tracking issue on GitHub, and page the on-call channel on Slack.

requiredCredentials.name: ops_github
requiredCredentials.purpose: Opens the incident tracking issue in your repo

alertName.description: Short alert name from your monitoring system

config.prompt: You are an SRE triage assistant. Classify the severity of this alert as EXACTLY one lowercase word, no punctuation: `sev1` | `sev2` | `sev3`. Then on a new line write a one-sentence rationale. Alert: {{context.trigger.output.alertName}} on {{context.trigger.output.service}} — {{context.trigger.output.summary}}

input.summary: Primary Postgres pool at 100% for 5m; new connections rejected.
